from: ไทดั้งเดิม
cf: จ้วงแบบจั่วเจียง

rule: เก็บ's eight senses are one hand doing four different jobs, and the object decides which. Taking a thing from where it grows or sits is 1. Putting a thing back where it belongs — tidying, finishing off — is 2. Picking up what is lying there, one at a time, is 3. Gathering many into one is 4. Calling in what is owed is 5. Sense 6 is the one that is not an act at all: holding something in a state over time, withheld from view or use, which is where เก็บอาการ and เก็บตัว belong rather than with the tidying.

notes.h2: 2026-09-21 — รม, ติด, เก็บ (30 filed, 21 tagged false-split) · a head that was almost all wreckage
notes.text:
**Rule.** เก็บ is one hand doing four jobs and the object decides which. Taking a
thing from where it grows or sits is 1 (เก็บดอกไม้). Putting a thing back where it
belongs — tidying, finishing off — is 2 (เก็บกวาด, เก็บผม). Picking up what is
lying there, one at a time, is 3 (เก็บตก, หมากเก็บ). Gathering many into one is 4
(เก็บเล่ม, เก็บเกี่ยว, เก็บความ, เก็บเล็ม). Calling in what is owed is 5 (เก็บข้าว,
เก็บกิน). Sense 6 is the one that is not an act at all — holding something in a
state over time, withheld from view or use — and that is where เก็บอาการ and
เก็บตัว belong, not with the tidying.

notes.h2: 2026-09-21 — รม, ติด, เก็บ (30 filed, 21 tagged false-split) · a head that was almost all wreckage
notes.text:
**ทางเก็บ at 3, with a flag.** The Thai-music style that fills every beat with
separate notes, against ทางกรอ's tremolo. I read its เก็บ as picking the notes up
one at a time, which is 3; it could as easily be 4, gathering. A musician would
settle it in a sentence and I could not.

notes.h2: 2026-09-21 — รม, ติด, เก็บ (30 filed, 21 tagged false-split) · a head that was almost all wreckage
notes.text:
**A neighbour I did not move.** เก็บไร — plucking the hairline to keep it neat —
sits at sense 6 from the similarity tier, dragged there by the
เพื่อรักษาไรผมให้งาม in its own gloss. By the rule above it is 2, tidying, beside
เก็บผม. It was filed `probable`, not by a source, so it is movable; I left it and
am writing it down instead of quietly re-filing a neighbour I was not sent to read.
